content.content: When invoked as `deccy init [path]`, the deccy CLI shall keep the `.deccy/` state directory untracked.
content.rationale: The state directory is deccy's alone — the marker file lives inside it (S5-marker-file) — and keeping `.deccy/` untracked is what keeps node listing and attribution from ever seeing it. Fixing the boundary here keeps a later verb from re-deciding it.
